feature: Find and document UI components missing i18n internationalization
description: Search through the frontend codebase to identify UI components that contain hardcoded text strings instead of using the i18n translation system. This includes React/Vue components with hardcoded English text in JSX/templates, labels, buttons, error messages, tooltips, and other user-facing strings. Document the findings in a structured list organized by component path, showing the hardcoded strings and suggesting translation keys. This task is critical for supporting international users and maintaining consistency across the application.

phases.name: Scan Frontend Codebase for Hardcoded Strings

subtasks.description: Scan all *.tsx and *.jsx files in apps/frontend/src/renderer/ to identify hardcoded text strings in JSX elements
Identify and catalog user-facing hardcoded strings (buttons, labels, placeholders, error messages, tooltips, dialog titles, menu items, aria-labels)
Review existing translation keys in apps/frontend/src/shared/i18n/locales/en/*.json and fr/*.json
subtasks.notes: Analyzed all 12 English translation files. Documented 2,500+ keys, naming conventions, and patterns. Created translation_files_analysis.md with comprehensive guidelines.

subtasks.description: Match hardcoded strings to existing translation keys where possible to avoid duplicates
subtasks.notes: Cross-referenced 200+ hardcoded strings with 2,500+ existing keys. Identified 80 strings (40%) that can reuse existing keys and 120 strings (60%) that need new keys. Created SUBTASK-2-2-KEY-MATCHING-REPORT.md with comprehensive matching strategy and implementation phases.

subtasks.description: Document each hardcoded string with exact component file path and line number
Suggest translation keys following existing namespace:section.key pattern (e.g., navigation:items.createSpec)
Organize report by component path and prioritize findings by severity (HIGH: labels/buttons, MEDIUM: tooltips/help text, LOW: aria-labels)
